name: osaga-demo
description: Orchestration-saga batch pipeline: an S3 upload emits an EventBridge event that triggers a Step Functions state machine, which runs an ECS Fargate Spring Batch task to transform the input CSV and write the result to an output bucket.

env.name: INPUT_BUCKET
env.description: S3 bucket holding the input CSV (passed as a RunTask override by Step Functions)

env.name: INPUT_KEY
env.description: S3 object key of the input CSV (from the S3 EventBridge event)

env.name: OUTPUT_BUCKET
env.description: S3 bucket to write the transformed CSV to

env.name: OUTPUT_KEY
env.description: S3 object key for the output CSV (defaults to processed/<input-filename> if unset)
